pages.text: Every fighter has a hidden $(l)pressure$() bar from 0 to 100. Landing hits fills the enemy's bar; taking hits fills yours.$(br2)While you're in a fight, a red bar replaces your experience bar: $(4)your$() pressure on one side, your $(4)target's$() on the other.

Pressure fades on its own after about two seconds without new pressure. Mobs drain slowly; players drain fast, so a crowd can't pin you down forever.$(br2)Each hit you land also relieves some of your own pressure: attacking is the best defense.
